lines: One evening... a fisherman caught the Sun.
Every night, the Sun sinks into the sea to sleep.
But that night, old Raghu's net came up... burning.
He hid the Sun in his hut. And morning... never came.
The sea froze. The birds went silent. The whole village shivered in the dark.
So he rowed into the black sea, and set the Sun free.
But first... he broke off one tiny crumb.
That's why we light diyas. Every little flame... is a crumb of the Sun.
